name: Reelbhai Shoppable Stories & Video for WooCommerce
author: Omar Faruk

sections.description:
This plugin turns your store into a short-video shop. Show vertical reels on any page, and let customers pick options and order without leaving the video.

Reels

  • Full-screen, swipe-up player with autoplay, mute control, likes and sharing
  • Tag one or more WooCommerce products on every reel
  • Quick order sheet: choose variation, quantity, then add to cart or order now
  • Optional “Order on WhatsApp” button with a ready-made message, light or dark sheet style, and a trust note line
  • Works with simple and variable products
  • Double-tap to like, seekable progress bar, loading spinner and blurred backdrop for any video shape
  • Hover preview on reel cards, sale and low-stock badges
  • Slider and grid layouts, Gutenberg blocks and shortcodes
  • Optional floating mini player that opens your reels from any page
  • Reels appear automatically on the product pages they are tagged to

Stories

  • Story circles grouped by name and avatar, with a seen/unseen ring
  • Image and video stories with progress bars, tap to go back or forward, hold to pause, swipe down to close
  • Optional product or link button on every story
  • Stories can hide themselves after a number of hours you choose

Analytics

  • Views, product clicks, add to cart, Order Now taps, WhatsApp taps, orders and revenue for each reel and story
  • Cover images can be generated automatically from the video
  • Orders placed after watching a reel are labelled on the WooCommerce order screen

Built for stores

  • Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS and the Cart and Checkout blocks
  • Mobile-first design, keyboard accessible, right-to-left ready
  • Assets load only on pages that show reels or stories
  • No external services, no tracking scripts, no names, emails or IP addresses stored

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external service by itself. One optional feature links to a third-party service when a visitor chooses to use it:

WhatsApp (wa.me): if you enter a WhatsApp number under Shoppable Reels → Settings → Ordering options, the order sheet shows an “Order on WhatsApp” button. When a visitor taps it, their browser opens a wa.me link containing your number and a pre-written message (product name, chosen options, quantity and product link). Nothing is sent before the visitor taps the button and nothing is sent by your server. WhatsApp’s terms and privacy policy apply: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/

If you add a video link from another website instead of uploading a video, visitors’ browsers load that video from the address you entered.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from Plugins → Add New.
  3. Activate Shoppable Reels through the Plugins screen.

Getting started

  1. Go to Shoppable Reels → Reels → Add New. Upload a vertical MP4, choose a cover image and tag your products.
  2. Go to Shoppable Reels → Stories → Story Groups to create a group (name and avatar), then add stories to it.

  3. Add the “Shoppable Reels” or “Shoppable Stories” block to any page, or use the shortcodes:

    [ofreels_reels layout=”slider” limit=”8″ columns=”4″]
    [ofreels_reels product=”current”]
    [ofreels_stories group=”new-arrivals”]
sections.faq:
Does it need WooCommerce?

Yes. This plugin is built for WooCommerce stores.

Which video format should I use?

Vertical MP4 (H.264) at 1080×1920 and a small file size give the best result on mobile.

Does it track my visitors?

No. Analytics only count events (views, clicks, orders). No names, emails or IP addresses are stored with the counts. To avoid counting the same tap many times, a hash made from the visitor’s IP address and browser is kept for a few seconds up to one minute (in the object cache when you have one, otherwise as a short-lived transient). A small cookie (ofreels_ref, 7 days) remembers which reel or story led to an add to cart so that the order can be attributed. A visitor’s likes and seen stories are kept in the browser’s local storage on their own device. Suggested text is added to your site’s privacy policy guide (Settings → Privacy).

Can I turn off the cookie?

Yes. If your site needs cookie consent, return false from the ofreels_attribution_cookie filter until the visitor has agreed. Orders are then simply not attributed to a reel or story.

add_filter( 'ofreels_attribution_cookie', '__return_false' );

Who can manage reels and stories?

Users who can manage WooCommerce (administrators and shop managers).

Are likes and view counts exact?

They are counted once per visitor within a short time window. Because anyone can open a public page, treat them as a popularity guide, not as an exact figure.

Can I remove all data on uninstall?

Yes. Enable “Delete all data on uninstall” under Shoppable Reels → Settings.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Security: reels, stories and story groups can now only be managed by users who can manage WooCommerce.
  • Privacy: suggested privacy policy text and a filter to turn off the attribution cookie.
  • Blocks are now registered with block.json.
  • Uninstall also removes temporary data and supports multisite.
  • New dashboard: period comparison, daily performance chart, customer journey funnel and top reels with thumbnails. Numbers load with AJAX and refresh automatically.
  • Settings: tabbed layout, live button preview, saving without a page reload, unsaved-changes notice.
  • Reels and stories lists: switch items on or off with one click.

1.1.0

  • New: hover preview, sale and low-stock badges, double-tap like, loading spinner, blurred backdrop, landscape video support, seekable progress bar.
  • New: “Order on WhatsApp” button, trust note, dark order sheet style, add-to-cart success animation.
  • New: optional floating mini player.
  • New: automatic cover image from the video, getting-started checklist, WhatsApp analytics.

1.0.0

  • First release.
